tasks.description: Independently verify the exact server candidate, including revoked-photo context replays.
constraints: Read-only independent Review and QA of the exact committed candidate. Run fresh checks. The prior run exhausted Developer retries on diff syntax after QA identified missing revoked-photo replay protection. The corrected candidate preserves legacy source revocation and tests an attached and then deleted plant belonging to the same owner. No deployment.

POST /analysis/jobs accepts optional closed initial_context for initial permanent-owner diagnosis only: light low/medium/bright_indirect/direct_sun/unknown, watering_frequency frequent/moderate/sparse/unknown, drainage yes/no/unknown. No arbitrary extra keys or fields from history. Validate before dispatch at HTTP and SQL. Only the context-bearing request routes to a new service_role-only SQL entry. Persist immutable values in diagnosis_job_runtime.initial_context; lease_diagnosis_job includes initial_context only if present. Keep repeat_context, outward result/receipt shape, provider start, quota and old no-context request behavior intact.

Use same owner lock and exact idempotency: new receipt hash covers base inputs and normalized exact context, scopes owner, replays accepted receipt even with unavailable worker, rejects changed context and conflict against legacy omission/mode. A guarded wrapper may reuse existing create_diagnosis_job then update exact new job, runtime and receipt hash atomically before returning; check no stale legacy receipt can be overwritten. Validate ACL, legacy replay, invalid/foreign scope, case-specific lease, changed/missing/extra context with pgTAP + Edge fixtures. Keep production T039/T098/T170 open until worker forwarding and normal live acceptance.
